concerns.text: FR-002 (geometry optimization) and FR-003 (descriptor generation) lack a completed task to invoke DFTB+ on the full dataset. T013a only handles a single molecule; T013c1 (orchestration), T013c3 (geometry export), and T013c4 (CSV export) are unchecked. Without these, US1 cannot produce `data/descriptors_semi.csv` or `data/optimized_geometries/`.

FR-004 (DFT subset) and FR-005 (paired t-test) are blocked. T020a (subset selection) and T020b (Psi4 invocation) are unchecked. T022 (evaluation/reporting) is unchecked and explicitly noted as missing the paired t-test logic and JSON output structure required for `reports/evaluation.json`.

FR-007 (sensitivity analysis) is unimplemented. T031c (aggregation and rank correlation logic) is unchecked. No task exists to produce `reports/sensitivity.csv` with the required stability metrics (rho >= 0.9) for SC-003.

FR-008 (confounding variable analysis) is incomplete. T011b4 (verification of `data/confounds.csv`) is unchecked. The task notes this is a blocking dependency for T020a (US2), preventing the entire US2 pipeline from starting.

Constitution Principle VII (Resource-Bound Execution) requires runtime/memory logs for every CI run. T033a (execute pipeline) and T033b (validate against 6h/7GB limits) are unchecked, meaning the project cannot demonstrate compliance with its own constitutional constraints.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle V (Versioning) require a complete reproducible environment. T002b (linting config `.ruff.toml`) is unchecked, violating the plan's requirement for a complete environment setup.

FR-001 (dataset checksum) is partially implemented, but the spec requires a JSON audit trail for DFT execution. T017 (DFT execution logging) is unchecked and missing the required JSON schema for `logs/dft_execution.log`, creating a gap in the audit trail.
